candidate.selection: Middle-band follow-up motivated by exploratory study; candidate selected on original discovery only. Independent confirmation seed2026102216, 32 new tables x four questions x three relocations. Freeze before confirmation capture.
candidate.tests: Confirmation native accuracy >=90%; translated-profile correlation advantage>0; translation-specific donor-phase benefit>0; right-minus-wrong geometric shift benefit>0. Table-bootstrap intervals. Partial phase-shift scale fitted on discovery only, not confirmation.

intervention.source: same semantic question, list at original location
intervention.scope: Full-model forward to first answer-token distribution, not full greedy-answer generation. Native destination magnitudes preserved, actual destination keys fixed. Compare source phase, source phase + lambda*omega*delta, source phase - lambda*omega*delta, and native.
